liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **ween2019-11-01.mbho.ka300.ka500.matrix.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 139 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer ranks this audience recording among the best they have heard in a while [6]
- **ween2019-11-01.MK012**: source not stated; 32 songs; 139 min [5]
- **ween2019-11-01.ak40.722**: source not stated; 32 songs; 139 min [2]
- **ween2019-11-01.dpa4080.flac24**: source not stated; 32 songs; 140 min [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2019-11-01.mbho.ka300.ka500.matrix.flac16**: taped by teamikoiko; transferred by teamikoiko; source: Source: MBHO ka300 (ORTF, 14ft, OTS/dfc) + MBHO ka500 (DINa)>Naiant PFA>MixPre6 (SD Card @ 24/48) [1]. Also: Captured to a MixPre6 on SD card at 24-bit/48k, then transferred via Reaper, CDWav, TLH FLAC level 6, and Foobar2000 tagging [1]
- **ween2019-11-01.MK012**: taped by Zachariah Boes; source: Oktava MK012>Fostex FR2-LE [5]. Also: Taped with Oktava MK012 mics into a Fostex FR2-LE at 24/48, positioned at the rail behind the soundboard; Edited in Sound Studio with slight EQ, normalization, fades and tracking, then encoded to FLAC with xACT [5]
- **ween2019-11-01.ak40.722**: taped by Melissa Fry; transferred by Melissa Fry; source: Neumann AK40> Sound Devices 722 [2]
- **ween2019-11-01.dpa4080.flac24**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: DPA 4080 > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (@ 24/48) [3]
